blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, BUKIDNON, Philippines — Holiday shoppers and cemetery visitors here experienced a mix of fright and festival energy on Saturday as local businesses and city organizers rolled out Halloween-themed attractions alongside the annual All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day exodus. Inside one of the city’s premier shopping malls, retail employees transformed into iconic horror figures to launch the store’s 6th annual “Spooky Halloween Special.” Wearing detailed prosthetics, elaborate makeup, and frightening costumes, staff members surprised unsuspecting shoppers throughout the aisles, drawing a blend of playful terror and festive excitement.
